component: Maxwell-V1-Flash (maxwell_moe) serving adapter and MLX model law: Block Sparse GQA, native MTP, APCv2 planes
source_repository: Maxwell-V1-Flash checkpoint local audited copies (model card names no hub revision; identified by the file digests below; both copies' reference files match them)
license: Apache-2.0 (checkpoint LICENSE and README section 6; file headers: Copyright 2026 the Maxwell team)
modifications: independent MLX implementation of the reference numerical law; no reference code is imported at runtime (tests import a digest-checked copy from a temp directory)
mHC residual streams (h_pre/h_post/Sinkhorn h_res, fp32 mapping math with the reference's casts) and the learned hc_head, folded with the final RMSNorm into one FinalNorm module
RMSNorm with fp32 weight multiply and one rounding, as the reference

Block Sparse GQA evaluated exactly at every length: contexts <= (8 prefix + 8 local + 16 remote) x 128 = 4096 tokens run dense causal SDPA (the route covers every causal block); beyond it the per-group indexer (4 x 128 queries, one shared post-RoPE key, fp32 block-max scores, top-16 eligible remote blocks, -inf picks dropped) builds the reference route; decode/verify rows gather the 32 routed blocks per group, longer chunks attend either the per-64-query union of routed blocks (default) or a block-membership mask over the whole key range

indexer keys are cached for every token as one extra plain KVCache plane per layer (cache list = 45 trunk planes then 45 indexer planes) so trim, batch merge/extract, rollback and APCv2 capture treat them as ordinary KV; left-padded BatchKVCache rows are evaluated per row

fp32 sigmoid routing, top-12 on scores + fp32 expert_bias, renormalised unbiased weights, ungated shared expert; per-expert w1/w3/w2 packed into SwitchGLU gate/up/down tables; the router returns (ids, weights) using the Laguna router contract
routed experts summed in fp32 and rounded once (the reference index_adds in the model dtype)
fp32 lm_head as the reference, stored fp32 at load (as are the router, mHC mapping and hc_head weights the reference casts per call)

native MTP layer (mtp_layers.0): enorm(embed(next token)) and per-stream hnorm(trunk streams) projected and summed into 4 streams, one dense-attention mHC MoE layer, its own hc_head + final norm into the shared fp32 head; the MTP multi-stream output chains to deeper draft positions; private KVCache whose offset counts pairs

mHC/RMSNorm spans run through mx.compile (same graph); opt-in levers MLX2_MAXWELL_MHC_KERNEL (fused Metal mHC pre/post), MLX2_MAXWELL_HEAD=bf16 (bf16-resident head, fp32-math GEMV kernel), MLX2_MAXWELL_FUSED_QKV (one q/k/v/indexer-k projection), MLX2_MAXWELL_SPARSE_PREFILL=masked
qwen3-coder XML tool calls through the shared parser and constrained-tool grammar (the checkpoint's chat template format)

opt-in MLX2_MAXWELL_CANONICAL_PICK (remote-block pick with lowest-index ties, ascending gather order) and MLX2_MAXWELL_ROW_EXACT_VERIFY=layerwise|serial (original mlx2 code on the shared row_exact_verify/row_exact protocol: native-MTP verify rows of a B=1 lane get the one-token decode arithmetic; weight-bearing projections and routed experts as canary-gated strips, mHC, norms, rope, cache update, attention, router and combine once per row through the decode code; multi-lane verify declined and counted); both default off (Pierre 2026-11-23)
validation: tests/test_maxwell_moe_cpu.py: tiny fp32 CPU parity against the digest-checked torch reference for logits and router ids/weights, the sparse route beyond the dense regime (union and masked long-chunk routes), cached decode through gather/union/masked routes with mixed chunk widths, left-padded BatchKVCache decode vs single rows, native MTP logits (all pairs and incremental through the private cache), fused projections, bf16-head fallback, kernel fail-closed, MTP tensor gate, registry descriptor, cache budget
real-checkpoint GPU validation: scripts/research/maxwell_overnight.py window (pending; Metal kernels are untested until it runs)

tests/test_maxwell_moe_cpu.py: row-exact verify logits, streams and every trunk/indexer cache plane bit-equal to one-token decode on CPU fp32 (dense and sparse regime, KVCache and BatchKVCache, layerwise and serial), while the batched verify differs; canonical pick unit test.
